tests.stimulus: Use fixed8warps/8groups/2fetch,known binary pins stable around rising edges and independent asynchronous reset. Establish sets and addresses through native dispatch,control and response histories only. Initialize nonzero workgroup membership,addresses,running/barrier state, then assert startup,midtraffic and wholly-between-edge reset pulses. Hold active controls during reset and inspect both state-derived and direct combinational outputs.
tests.expected: All registered histories clear asynchronously, including workgroup membership after a short pulse; direct control outputs continue their documented current-pin functions. Invalid payloads remain exact rather than unconstrained.
tests.checker: A self-contained independent model predicts abstract running/waiting/group-member sets and mathematical per-bank address/mask histories from inputs only. Separate actual/expected wires feed four-state comparisons1ns after rising clk and asynchronous reset; any mismatch emits UVM_ERROR,with finite stimulus and mandatory sample/reset counts.
